annotations.title: Estimate a building of a given size

description: What a LEVA building of a given size costs to build: total, materials, labour (execution) and hours in USD with a low-high range, from LEVA's priced reference designs of that product, plus the nearest reference design and a link that opens LEVA's 3D configurator at exactly that size with an itemized bill of materials. Use it for questions like 'how much does a 20 x 30 ft ADU / 12 x 16 shed / barndominium cost to build'. Estimates, not quotes.

area.description: instead of width and length: the floor area (sq ft, or m2 with unit m)

market.description: optional two-letter country code for local material prices, e.g. DE, GB, CA

product.description: the product handle from list_products, e.g. adu, barndominium, shed, sauna-1

roof.description: optional roof shape: gable, hip, halfhip, mono, flat

unit.description: unit of width / length / area (default ft)

name: estimate_build
title: Estimate a building of a given size
